guidance: Avoid clustering too many abstract/process posts back-to-back.
Let product/wearability appear every 2-3 posts so the page stays commercially legible.
Use transformation/carousel posts as anchor pieces in the grid.
Use Reels for movement, proof, and first-two-second hooks.
Never repeat the exact same image pairing in the same order. If images must be reused, change order, role, and narrative purpose.
Rotate product families before reusing a recently featured garment unless the format or story is meaningfully different.
Avoid clustering posts with the same palette, brightness, density, or visual family in one row unless the row intentionally needs that weight.
Use Photoshoot / Campaign assets as premium body/campaign anchors once available.
Use folded cloth, canvas, quiet product-detail crops, and negative-space mockups as text backdrops, transition slides, or feed breakers when the grid needs breathing room.

visual_slots.name: slide-01.png
visual_slots.notes: 4:5 crop, keep the headline block centered-left with generous top and right breathing room. | Keep dark, dense, high-contrast; slightly lift blacks so text reads premium, add subtle grain, no extra effects. | Best opener for a recovery post because it resets the story and immediately explains the system.

visual_slots.name: slide-02.png
visual_slots.notes: 4:5 crop, preserve the light palette and leave the lower third open for the body copy. | Use the brightest slide as relief; keep contrast soft, add minimal grain, avoid heavy darkening. | This is the pacing slide that gives the row breathing room and breaks the black/dark cluster.

visual_slots.name: Distressed Grommet Eyelet Tank Top-mockups-3.png
visual_slots.notes: 4:5 crop, zoom into a quiet fabric/detail area with empty edge space for small text if needed. | Treat as a texture surface; soften saturation, keep fabric detail crisp, add slight film grain, avoid mockup-looking shine. | A product-derived surface adds commercial usefulness without collapsing the carousel into isolated product selling.

visual_slots.name: slide-04.png
visual_slots.notes: 4:5 crop, keep headline dominant and the bottom text block fully legible. | Maintain dark editorial tone; sharpen text edges slightly, preserve empty margins, no extra overlays. | Strongest closing statement for launch recovery: it turns context into product logic and sets up the next posts.
